compositionBoundary: Consumes the signed provider receipt and post-materialization executable assay from the semantic-candidate-review service. The result must bind the exact CandidatePatchK, RequirementSetK, provider attribution, outcome, and replay material; author identity neither proves nor disproves correctness.
receipt: VerificationOutcomeK preserves provider receipt, review subject, real endpoint, fresh-process digest, timestamps, exact candidate and requirements, executable command, artifact digests, outcome, and economics.
refusal: Refuse pre-materialization runs, wrong candidate/requirements, missing signed-provider receipt, non-interface endpoints, empty, unbound, or assay artifacts, provider authority over the distinct customer-outcome judgment, or malformed timestamps.
acceptance: Passed verification is never customer acceptance or demand closure. Only urn:leader:emsenn may issue the separate CustomerOutcomeK.
